caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and depicts a single ornate pitcher or jug with a curvilinear body, wide rounded base, and a flared spout. The pitcher has three decorative feet and a large, elaborately curved handle. The main object is centered within a rectangular border. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller box containing two profile sketches, presumably studies of the handle and foot of the pitcher, each showing their outlines from different perspectives. In the lower right corner, another small box contains a technical sketch of the pitcher with dimensions marked around it, showing the object’s side profile and basic measurements. The artist's signature, "Charles Cullen," is written in cursive at the bottom left outside the main border. The background is a plain, uncolored surface.
title: Pewter Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
